activity_summary: Walking north up Bishopsgate Street toward the gate, you passed Barnaby Yaxley's barber-surgeon shop, where your tooth was drawn for twelvepence eight days since, on the Tuesday. You walked past. You did not go in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Passed Yaxley's shop and walked on toward the gate.

entities.name: Barnaby Yaxley
entities.context: Named, and not spoken to. The door stayed a door.

entities.name: Bishopsgate Street
entities.context: Mentioned in Walked past Yaxley's shop

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Today I walk past his window with my mouth shut and my tongue in an empty place.
